trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

1. **Diagnosis**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and never healthy anywhere, so it was ruled out).

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions. Rollout succeeded.

3. **Verification**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18%).

4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 due to failing health checks"), which paged the on-call engineer.
